physics_goals.quote: The key physical objectives of the collaboration are: Dark Sector Searches Few-Body Systems Hadron Structure Nuclear Astrophysics Search for Dark Matter with DarkMESA
physics_goals.value: Dark sector searches, few-body systems, hadron structure and nuclear astrophysics with electron scattering on a gas jet target, plus the DarkMESA beam-dump dark matter search

summary.plain: MAGIX (Mainz Gas Injection Target Experiment) will scatter MESA's intense electron beam off a thin gas jet and detect the electrons in two high-resolution spectrometers, to study few-body systems and hadron structure, and to search for a dark photon and other dark-sector particles.
summary.technical: MAGIX at MESA: internal gas-jet target, two high-resolution magnetic spectrometers with time projection chambers and a trigger/veto system, silicon-strip recoil detectors; electron scattering for dark-sector searches (A' to e+e-), few-body systems, hadron structure (proton radius, form factors) and nuclear astrophysics; the beam-dump experiment DarkMESA is part of the same collaboration.

unique_capabilities.quote: Central components of the MAGIX experiment at MESA are an internal gas jet target, two high-resolution magnetic spectrometers equipped with advanced tracking detectors and a trigger/veto system, as well as supplementary recoil detectors.
unique_capabilities.value: Internal gas-jet target with two high-resolution magnetic spectrometers, advanced tracking detectors, a trigger/veto system and recoil detectors
